editorial:
Imagine being a twelve-year-old girl who discovers her rich and powerful mother is actually a cold-blooded killer. That is the wild start you get here. Alice is a brave kid who tries to tell the police the truth, but since her mom has all the money and power, nobody believes her. She decides to run away to Portugal to find her dad, even though the cops think he is long gone. You get this cool mix of a chase movie and a survival story as Alice finds an unlikely friend in Hugo, a tough ex-soldier who knows how to fight. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where a little girl is being hunted by both the law and a private army.

What really works is the bond between the kid and the hitman, which gives the movie some heart. The action scenes are punchy and keep the story moving fast, though some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable. If you like thrillers that keep you guessing, you will enjoy the ride. It is best to watch this streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the Portuguese scenery, or you can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best quality. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend movie night.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in Portugal where Alice finally finds the truth about her father. It turns out her mother was lying about him being dead to keep Alice under her thumb. After a final big fight with the paramilitary team, Hugo helps Alice escape her mother's grasp for good. The movie wraps up with the bad guys defeated and Alice finally safe, proving that her instincts about her mother were right all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chase movies and unlikely friendships.
